senses.gloss: havala, nt., a high number: Mvy 〔7910〕 = Tib. ljab ljib; cited from Gv, and occurs in Gv 〔106.15〕 (˚lasya) following hava(sya), see next, but both accidentally omitted in Gv 〔133.26〕, in the list which is the actual source of the Mvy list.

havava, var. havaca (so Mironov with v.l. havava in 〔246.85〕), in Gv hava, m., a high number: Mvy 〔7781〕; [] 〔7909〕, in both = Tib. bgraṅ yal (in 〔7909〕 var. ˚yas); in 〔7909〕 cited from Gv, which in 〔106.15〕 has -hava(sya, gen.) just before -havala, q.v. (omitted in Gv 〔133.26〕).
